{{Quote|Ay Dee Seven Four Two, have Ajaf and Matham reported in to you yet?|Unknown Stormtrooper to AD-742|<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />}}
'''AD-742''' or '''Ay Dee Seven Four Two''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]] and served under [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. He participated in the search for [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ton Phanan]] when his [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] crashed on the planet.<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />
